description: This Java source file defines the class AndroidExtractStyleAction, which provides functionality for extracting style attributes from Android XML layout tags into separate style resources within an IDE or development environment.

classes.name: AndroidExtractStyleAction
classes.description: Provides functionality to extract style attributes from Android XML layout tags into style resources, including UI dialog interactions and refactoring logic.

methods.name: doExtractStyle
methods.description: Performs the extraction of style attributes from a given XML tag into a style resource, optionally adding a style attribute to the original tag.

methods.name: getExtractableAttributes
methods.description: Returns a list of attributes from an XML tag that are eligible for extraction into a style resource.

methods.name: canBeExtracted
methods.description: Determines if a specific XML attribute can be extracted into a style resource based on namespace and attribute name.

methods.name: doRefactorForTags
methods.description: Executes the refactoring process for a single XML tag.
